summary: Real-estate portfolio domain foundation adds property/rental-object registration metadata, lease-contract registration metadata, lease cash-flow projection metadata, space-occupancy planning metadata, facility-maintenance linkage metadata, and SAP RE-FX parity-map linkage while explicitly refusing durable real-estate persistence, SAP RE-FX or SAP Cloud for Real Estate integration, lease-accounting engines, GL/AP/AR posting, payment execution, plant-maintenance work orders, workspace/team synchronization, document archives, Workflow execution, cloud deployment, and runtime audit-chain claims.
non_claims: no SAP Cloud for Real Estate integration
no Microsoft Dynamics 365 Asset leasing integration
no accounts payable or accounts receivable posting
no statutory filing or IFRS/ASC certification
no production SAP RE-FX parity claim

findings: The slice is additive and isolates real-estate portfolio invariants in a flat microservice crate rather than widening Enterprise Suite into a RE-FX/ERP monolith.
The API remains pure data-in/data-out with no I/O, durable state, lease-accounting engine, GL/AP/AR posting, plant-maintenance work orders, workspace sync, Workflow execution, or cloud runtime.

claims_allowed: ERP parity-map linkage for SAP RE-FX
findings: Independent scaling and deployment remain future adapter/runtime work; this slice only creates the pure domain foundation.

F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: Tests fail if missing property registration, missing lease registration, unsafe refs, credential-shaped evidence refs, invalid dates, invalid areas, capacity shortage, invalid terms, zero amounts, invalid periods, or invalid maintenance windows are accepted.
findings: Positive property-to-lease-to-cash-flow-to-space-to-facility flow and negative guard rails are covered.
Types map directly to properties, rental objects, lease contracts, cash flows, occupancy plans, and facility linkage common to RE-FX and lease-management systems.

build live RE-FX/cloud lease-accounting runtime now

F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: A flat domain foundation gives SAP RE-FX parity a service-owned first write path while keeping SAP/Oracle/Microsoft integrations, lease-accounting engines, GL/AP/AR/payment posting, PM work orders, workspace/team sync, document archives, Workflow, and cloud adapters out of scope.
rejected_reasons: Leaving RE-FX as a gap keeps the ERP parity map with a flat-service-required row after GTS, CRM, SCM/APO, PM, QM, PP, warehouse, procurement, and treasury foundations landed.

Live real-estate/lease-management runtime requires durable property stores, accounting integrations, payment rails, plant-maintenance adapters, document archives, operational SLOs, and cloud evidence beyond this slice.

findings: No credentials, external network calls, SAP/Oracle/Microsoft integrations, accounting postings, payment executions, work-order creations, workspace reservations, or Workflow dispatches are introduced.
Team, maintenance-asset, source, and audit refs reject traversal, whitespace/control, and credential-shaped strings.
